# rules-mobile.md — mis-mobile (Expo SDK 57 / React Native, mobile)

Binding for every agent and human working in this repo. `rules-common.md` applies too; where they conflict, this file wins for this repo. **The repo's own `AGENTS.md` (Expo-generated) is the authority: where this file conflicts with it, `AGENTS.md` wins.**

---

## 1. Stack

- Language / runtime: TypeScript ~6.0.3, `strict: true` (`tsconfig.json`); Node 20.19+ / 22 LTS (`README.md`)
- Framework: Expo SDK 57 (`expo ~57.0.30`), React Native 0.86.3, React 19.2.3, Expo Router ~57.0.28 with typed routes and React Compiler enabled (`package.json`, `app.json`). Push: `expo-notifications` + `expo-device` (`package.json`). Token storage: `expo-secure-store` (decided 2026-10-16; to be installed with `npx expo install`).
- Package manager: npm (`package-lock.json`); add packages only with `npx expo install <pkg>` (`AGENTS.md`)
- Database: none on device. Data comes from mis-backend at `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL` (`.env.example`)
- Commands: dev `npx expo start` · test none · lint `npx expo lint` · typecheck `npx tsc --noEmit` · build `npx eas-cli@latest build` (`AGENTS.md`, `package.json`)

## 2. Layer Chain (build order)

1. types
2. api-client
3. hooks / store (plain hooks + React context)
4. component
5. screen (route)
6. test? (no runner yet)

| Layer | Folder | Naming | Base / Wiring | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| types | `src/types/` | kebab-case `*.ts`, PascalCase exported types | plain TS types/interfaces, imported as `@/types/...` | framework default (`tsconfig.json` alias `@/*`) |
| api-client | `src/api/` | kebab-case `*.ts`, exported verb-named async functions | `fetch` wrapper; base URL `process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL`; `Authorization: Bearer <Sanctum token>` | framework default; `.env.example` |
| hooks / store | `src/hooks/` | `use-<name>.ts` exporting `useName()` | plain React hooks; session/auth through a context provider mounted in `src/app/_layout.tsx` (decided 2026-10-16) | `src/hooks/use-theme.ts` |
| component | `src/components/` (primitives in `components/ui/`) | kebab-case file, named PascalCase export; `*.web.tsx` for web variants | `StyleSheet.create` at file bottom; colors via `useTheme()` / `ThemedText` / `ThemedView`; tokens from `@/constants/theme` | `src/components/themed-text.tsx` |
| screen (route) | `src/app/` | route file name = URL segment; `_layout.tsx` = navigator | `export default function XScreen()`; navigation via `expo-router` | `src/app/_layout.tsx` |
| test? | none yet | — | — | — |

## 3. Layer Rules

- **Routes only in `src/app/`.** Every file there is a screen; `_layout.tsx` defines navigators. Components, hooks and utils never go in `src/app/` (`AGENTS.md`).
- **Navigation only through Expo Router** (`Link`, `router`, `useLocalSearchParams` from `expo-router`) (`AGENTS.md`).
- **Screens compose; they don't fetch.** Screens call hooks, hooks call api-client, only api-client calls `fetch` (framework default).
- **State is plain hooks + context over `fetch`** — no state-management or data-fetching library (decided 2026-10-16).
- **api-client is the single place** that knows the base URL, attaches the Bearer token and turns non-2xx responses into thrown errors (framework default).
- **Components are presentational.** Props in; theme tokens from `@/constants/theme` / `useTheme()`; no API calls; no hardcoded hex colors outside `theme.ts` (`src/constants/theme.ts`).
- **Template cleanup (decided 2026-10-16):** the template demo screens/components are removed by hand (not via `npm run reset-project`); the theme files (`src/constants/theme.ts`, `src/hooks/use-theme.ts`, `use-color-scheme*.ts`, themed components) are kept.
- **Platform differences** go in `*.web.tsx` / `*.web.ts` siblings or `Platform.select` (`src/components/app-tabs.web.tsx`).
- **Imports use the `@/` alias** (`tsconfig.json`).
- **React Compiler is on.** No manual `useMemo`/`useCallback` without a measured reason (`app.json`).
- **Expo APIs are verified** against `https://docs.expo.dev/versions/v57.0.0/` or `https://docs.expo.dev/llms.txt` before use; prefer Expo modules over third-party libraries (`AGENTS.md`).

## 4. Data & Validation

- Where input is validated: client-side form checks in the screen or hook for UX only; mis-backend validation is authoritative (framework default).
- Where persistence happens: on mis-backend. Locally only the Sanctum token (in `expo-secure-store`) and transient UI state (decided 2026-10-16).
- Response / error shape: Laravel JSON from mis-backend; validation errors are 422 `{message, errors}` (framework default). api-client throws a typed error; hooks expose `{data, error, loading}`.
- Pagination / unbounded queries: attendance history is requested paginated or date-bounded; never fetch an unbounded list (framework default).

## 5. Cross-cutting

- Auth: students and parents log in to mis-backend and get a Sanctum token, stored with `expo-secure-store` and sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (decided 2026-10-16). Never store it in AsyncStorage or plain files.
- Authorisation / permissions: a student sees only their own attendance, a parent only their linked student(s); the backend enforces this, the app only hides UI (framework default).
- Scoping / tenancy: per-user as above; no multi-tenancy.
- Push notifications: mis-backend sends attendance-scan pushes through the **Expo push service** (decided 2026-10-16). The app registers its Expo push token with the backend. This needs a development build (not Expo Go on Android), the `expo-notifications` config plugin in `app.json`, an EAS project id, and FCM credentials later (`README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, decided 2026-10-16). Configure native behaviour only through `app.json` plugins.
- Logging: no logging library; no `console.*` left in committed code (rules-common 14).
- Config / secrets: never hardcode; read from `process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_*` (`.env`, template `.env.example`). `EXPO_PUBLIC_*` values ship inside the bundle, so they never hold secrets (framework default).

## 6. Tests

- Framework: none installed; no test runner yet (decided 2026-10-16).
- Location & naming: n/a. If one is added later, never put tests under `src/app/` — every file there becomes a route (`AGENTS.md`).
- Required per change: `npx expo lint` and `npx tsc --noEmit` pass (decided 2026-10-16; `AGENTS.md`). `tsc` reports 2 known template errors (CSS module / `global.css` declarations) until `expo-env.d.ts` is generated by the first `npx expo start`.
- Fixtures / factories: none.

## 7. Prohibitions

- DO NOT add packages with `npm install <pkg>` / `yarn add`; use `npx expo install <pkg>` (`AGENTS.md`).
- DO NOT create or hand-edit `ios/` or `android/` (Continuous Native Generation); use `app.json` and config plugins (`AGENTS.md`, `.gitignore`).
- DO NOT put non-route code in `src/app/` (`AGENTS.md`).
- DO NOT use a navigation library other than Expo Router (`AGENTS.md`).
- DO NOT add a state-management or data-fetching library; plain hooks + context (decided 2026-10-16).
- DO NOT write Expo/EAS/RN API code from memory; check the v57 docs first (`AGENTS.md`).
- DO NOT store the auth token anywhere but `expo-secure-store` (decided 2026-10-16).
- DO NOT commit `.env`, put secrets in `EXPO_PUBLIC_*`, or hardcode the API host (`.gitignore`, `.env.example`).
- DO NOT declare a task done without running lint and typecheck (`AGENTS.md`).

## 8. Self-Audit Checklist

Run on every touched file before finishing.

- [ ] File is in the correct layer folder; only routes/layouts in `src/app/`
- [ ] Kebab-case filename; named PascalCase export for components; `useX` for hooks; default export only for route screens
- [ ] Imports use `@/`
- [ ] Expo APIs checked against the SDK 57 docs
- [ ] New deps added via `npx expo install`; native config via `app.json` plugins only
- [ ] No hardcoded colors, API URL or secrets
- [ ] Network calls only in api-client; token sent as Bearer and stored in `expo-secure-store`
- [ ] Web/native differences handled via `*.web.tsx` or `Platform.select`
- [ ] `npx expo lint` passes
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` passes (except the 2 known template errors until `expo-env.d.ts` exists)
